title: ChemDataExtractor: A Toolkit for Automated Extraction of Chemical Information from the Scientific Literature
claim_supported: chemical entities and properties can be extracted at useful accuracy
study_design: rule-based chemistry-aware NLP evaluated on several extraction tasks
key_result: reported F-scores of 93.4% for identifiers 86.8% for spectroscopic attributes and 91.5% for property attributes
limitation: not designed for negative evidence semantics or modern multimodal documents

title: Application of Large Language Models in Chemistry Reaction Data Extraction and Cleaning
claim_supported: LLMs can map unstructured reaction reports into a user-defined schema
study_design: manual dataset plus prompt tuning fine-tuning and verifier comparisons
key_result: GPT-4 prompt tuning gave the best reported extraction results; smaller fine-tuned models remained useful
limitation: small five-page study; nuanced chemical information remained difficult

title: ChemMiner: A Large Language Model Agent System for Chemical Literature Data Mining
claim_supported: an agent pipeline can recover reaction fields from text images and tables
study_design: 1940-paper collection and expert benchmark containing 326 reactions
key_result: average precision 90.15% recall 77.13% and F1 83.11% for reactant solvent yield and product extraction
limitation: benchmark labels only a selected subset and is not negative-evidence-specific

title: ReactionSeek: LLM-powered literature data mining and knowledge discovery in organic synthesis
claim_supported: key reaction parameters can be extracted from archival literature
study_design: Organic Syntheses archive plus a 50-reaction benchmark from supporting information of six papers
key_result: reported over 95% precision and recall for key parameters and high performance on identifiers quantities yields solvents conditions and ee
limitation: curated organic-synthesis corpus; negative and failed reactions were not the central target

title: Data Mining Approach for Extraction of Bioassay Descriptions from Scientific Publications
claim_supported: assay descriptions and categories can be mined from publications
key_result: demonstrates extraction and categorization of assay descriptions needed to interpret activity observations
limitation: database and publication descriptions can be incomplete; no dedicated negative-evidence benchmark

title: From text to insight: large language models for chemical data extraction
claim_supported: evaluation and ground truth remain unresolved across extraction pipelines
study_design: critical review of LLM-based chemical extraction
key_result: identifies precision recall provenance ground truth and domain validation as central requirements
limitation: review evidence; does not report a negative-evidence extraction system
